home.practice_showdown_blurb: Fixed-limit hold'em against three rivals who each play their own way. Twelve hands, a hundred chips, and whatever you stand up with.
showdown.title: Showdown
showdown.how_to: You hold two cards. Five more turn face up in the middle, three, then one, then one, and the best five of your seven makes your hand. Before the first turn and after each, everyone still in folds, calls (or checks), or raises (or bets) by a fixed amount. Last one in, or the best hand when the cards are shown, takes the pot.
showdown.how_to_keyboard: F folds, C calls or checks, R raises or bets, and space deals the next hand. 1, 2 and 3 press the buttons left to right.
showdown.styles_note: Each rival plays one way all sitting, and its seat says which. A brick folds to pressure, a sponge calls anything, a hothead raises with less than it should, a shark plays it straight.
showdown.bank_note: You sit down with {bank} chips and play {hands} hands. Leave early and you keep none of your winnings.
showdown.hint_note: Practice rounds suggest a move when you pause.
showdown.legend_ring: Rings, a planet and its ring.
showdown.legend_comet: Comets, a head and its tail.
showdown.legend_back: A card face down. A rival shows its cards only if it stays to the end.
showdown.legend_button: The button. The two seats after it post the blinds, and it acts last after the flop.
showdown.legend_brick: Brick: folds unless it holds something, and rarely raises. Push it off pots.
showdown.legend_sponge: Sponge: calls almost anything and seldom raises. Never bluff it; bet your good hands.
showdown.legend_hothead: Hothead: bets and raises with too little. Let it bet into you.
showdown.legend_shark: Shark: plays its cards and the price straight.
showdown.legend_ranks: Hands from best: straight flush, four of a kind, full house, flush, straight, three of a kind, two pairs, a pair, high card.
